headline: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
detail: This is a strong bullish signal for the semiconductor sector, suggesting robust demand and growth. Given your heavy concentration in chip names like SOXL and SMH, this could provide a tailwind, but remember SOXL is leveraged and has its own decay issues.
rec: Consider adding to core chip holdings like SMH if it shows strength, or look at scanner setups for AMD/TSM/MRVL. MRVL (ACCUMULATE) entry 240.95-240.71, stop 240.09.

headline: AI was supposed to kill Google search. These numbers show the opposite, analyst says.
detail: This headline is positive for Google, indicating its core business is resilient against AI disruption. This is good news for your QQQ and QQQI holdings, which have significant GOOGL exposure.
rec: No direct action needed now, but keep an eye on GOOGL. Scanner has GOOGL on WATCH, entry 345.27-344.93, stop 344.24.

headline: Why growth stocks’ surprising strength may be warning of a market bubble
detail: This is a significant warning for your portfolio, which is heavily concentrated in growth-oriented tech/chip names and traded on margin. A market correction would amplify losses.
rec: Re-evaluate your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and consider trimming other "TRIM" status holdings like SMH and QQQI to reduce overall risk exposure.

headline: How record diesel prices will rip through the U.S. economy. Trucks, rails are only the start
detail: Rising diesel prices can impact supply chains, transportation costs, and consumer spending, potentially leading to broader economic slowdown. This could indirectly affect tech demand and overall market sentiment.
rec: This reinforces caution. Avoid new speculative buys and prioritize risk management in your existing leveraged and underperforming positions.
